settings.question: Is your refurbished tech brand new?
settings.answer: No. Unboxed refurbished tech is pre-owned, but every device is carefully inspected, tested, cleaned and approved before it is listed for sale.

settings.question: Does Fair, Good or Like New affect performance?
settings.answer: No. The grade is cosmetic. All devices are fully tested and expected to work properly, but the amount of visible wear changes between grades.

settings.question: Do you only sell smartphones?
settings.answer: No. Our refurbished tech range also includes tablets, laptops, gaming products and smartwatches, each listed with clear condition grading.

settings.question: Do devices arrive reset and ready to use?
settings.answer: Yes. Devices are cleaned, reset where applicable and prepared so they are ready for setup when they arrive.

settings.question: Do refurbished tech orders come with support and returns?
settings.answer: Yes. Orders include support and a clear returns process so you can shop with confidence. Any warranty or returns details are available on the relevant policy pages.
